meta.source: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, TradeStat (DGCI&S customs data)
meta.coverage: India's merchandise exports by principal commodity (the groups the monthly press release uses: petroleum, gold, electronics, pulses, rice and about 165 more), every month since April 2009, ₹ crore
meta.note: TradeStat FTPA principal-commodity tables, which print only April-to-month running totals. Each month here is derived: this month's running total minus last month's, both from the same print (R from the tables a year later where they exist, else the provisional P tables). 'total' is derived the same way from the printed total.
